data.credibility: Management issues varied guidance across international and domestic metrics, but frequently drops topics in subsequent quarters without tracking them fully. While they reiterate long-term double-digit growth, shorter-term regional and capex targets often transition to dropped or slipping statuses.

lines.line: Promised early teens international growth; actual reached 26.5%, though topic was dropped in reporting.
Targeted $100M international foods in 2-3 years, but the topic was subsequently dropped.
Guided 80% or higher South Africa volume growth, but the topic was dropped.
Guided double-digit growth for 5-10 years; actual stands at 26.5% and remains on track.
Guided India capex under Rs. 500-600 crore, but management later raised it, slipping.
Promised half a million new outlets this year, and the target remains on track.
Guided international capex between $90M and $100M for CY27; status is pending.

overrides.reason: Actual international growth reached 26.5%, exceeding the early teens target despite being dropped in later commentary.

bull: Consolidated revenue stands strong at ₹25,931 crore with a net profit of ₹3,479 crore and a healthy EBITDA margin of 22.8%.
Profit after tax increased by 16.2% to 30,620.4 Million in CY 2025, supported by steady volume growth of 7.9%.
The balance sheet remains lightly geared with borrowings of ₹2,508 crore against a net worth of ₹19,578 crore (debt-to-equity of 0.13).
bear: Management frequently drops specific guidance topics in subsequent quarters, making consistent accountability difficult to track.
India capex guidance has already shown friction with management raising figures away from the initial Rs. 500 to 600 crore target range.
Valuation reflects high expectations with a P/E ratio of 41.8 alongside a moderate ROCE of 19.7% and ROE of 16.4%.
